description: This file defines the 'Ip' model class within the Opencart fraud extension. It manages IP addresses flagged for fraud by creating, deleting, and querying a dedicated database table.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: The Ip class handles CRUD operations related to fraudulent IP addresses within the Opencart fraud extension, including installing/uninstalling the associated database table and managing IP data.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'fraud_ip' table in the database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'fraud_ip' table from the database if it exists.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Inserts a new IP address into the 'fraud_ip' table with the current timestamp.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Deletes an IP address from the 'fraud_ip' table.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of IP addresses from the table, ordered ascending.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Returns the total count of IP addresses stored in the table.

methods.name: getTotalIpsByIp
methods.description: Returns the count of entries matching a specific IP address.
